combos.guide: These are all images that may be exported (thumbnails are approximate). Click an image to preview it and select its options.
combos.tooMany: There are too many combinations, so only the first {n} are shown. Reduce participating groups or add exclusions.
combos.none: No combinations can be exported. Check the option groups and cross-group rules.
combos.hint: Unticked combinations will not be exported; click the image itself to preview it.
combos.manifestTitle: Save the index, filename, and options for the current export scope
